title: BoundInk: Boundary-Aware Online Handwriting Generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.02103v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Realistic online handwriting depends not only on individual character shapes, but also on how a writer connects, spaces, and aligns adjacent characters. Existing methods rely primarily on long-range sequence modeling and capture these inter-character behaviors only implicitly. This often produces plausible glyphs accompanied by broken cursive joins, inconsistent spacing, or writer-inconsistent transitions. We introduce BoundInk, a writer-conditioned framework that treats inter-character boundaries as explicit generation units. By jointly modeling local transitions and surrounding text context, BoundInk preserves writer-specific glyph appearance while improving connectivity and spacing across complete text lines. We further introduce a boundary-aware evaluation framework that directly assesses cursive continuity and spatial relationships between characters beyond conventional trajectory similarity. translated_title: BoundInk：边界感知的在线手写生成
translated_abstract: 逼真的在线手写不仅取决于单个字符的形状，还取决于书写者如何连接、间隔和对齐相邻字符。现有方法主要依赖长程序列建模，只能隐式地捕捉这些字符间行为，这往往导致生成的字形看似合理，却伴随连笔断裂、间距不一致或与书写者风格不符的过渡。我们提出 BoundInk，一个以书写者为条件的框架，将字符间边界作为显式的生成单元。通过联合建模局部过渡与周围文本上下文，BoundInk 在保留书写者特有字形外观的同时，改善了完整文本行中的连贯性与间距。我们进一步提出了一个边界感知的评估框架，能够超越传统的轨迹相似度，直接评估连笔的连续性以及字符之间的空间关系。在三个基准匹配的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: BoundInk 将字符间边界作为显式生成单元，在保留书写者风格的同时显著提升在线手写的连笔连贯性与间距一致性，并首次提出边界感知的评估框架来直接衡量字符间的连续性与空间关系。
en_tdlr: BoundInk treats inter-character boundaries as explicit generation units to improve cursive connectivity and spacing while preserving writer style, and introduces a boundary-aware evaluation framework that directly assesses continuity and spatial relationships between characters.
